stories.title: NASA Successfully Launches Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
stories.summary: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The telescope, which is expected to survey hundreds of millions of stars and billions of galaxies, will take over three months to reach its observation point one million miles away. Named after NASA's first chief astronomer, the telescope aims to explore some of the universe's biggest mysteries.

stories.title: Ferry Capsizes off Northern Cyprus, Leaving Several Dead and Many Missing
stories.summary: A ferry carrying nearly 270 passengers and crew capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in at least seven confirmed deaths. Local authorities reported that 237 individuals have been rescued, while 23 remain unaccounted for. Rescue operations are ongoing as search teams work to locate those missing.

stories.title: Niger Junta Regains Control After Mutiny with Russian Support
stories.summary: In Niger's capital, a mutiny by soldiers targeting the presidential palace and a military airbase was suppressed with assistance from Russian paramilitary forces. The junta reported that dozens of soldiers were killed or arrested during the unrest, which posed a significant threat to their authority. Life in the capital has since returned to normal following the intervention.

stories.title: Iceland Votes to Reject EU Membership Talks in Referendum
stories.summary: In a recent referendum, Icelanders voted against reopening talks for European Union membership, with 52.8% of voters rejecting the proposal. The decision halts the government's efforts to revive accession discussions, emphasizing concerns over the protection of Iceland's fishing waters. The outcome reflects a divided public opinion on the issue.

stories.title: Search Ongoing After Fatal Shooting at Swiss Rave Leaves One Dead and Five Injured
stories.summary: A manhunt is currently underway following a shooting at a rave in Aarau, Switzerland, which resulted in the death of a 22-year-old woman and injuries to five others. The incident occurred during a techno party at a covered horse-racing track in the early hours of Sunday. Local police are actively searching for the unidentified perpetrator or perpetrators involved in the attack.

stories.title: Death Toll from Nepal-Tibet Floods Approaches 800 with Thousands Missing
stories.summary: Rescue efforts continue in the aftermath of catastrophic flash floods in the Nepal-Tibet region, with the death toll reaching nearly 800. As of now, over 3,000 people remain unaccounted for, including 2,502 in Nepal and 546 in Tibet. Heavy rain is hampering rescue operations, complicating the search for survivors.

stories.title: Guinea-Bissau Holds Referendum to Enhance Presidential Powers Amid Controversy
stories.summary: Voters in Guinea-Bissau participated in a referendum to amend the constitution, aiming to increase presidential powers. The military government, which took control last year, is proposing changes that would allow the president to appoint and dismiss the prime minister. This vote precedes planned elections in December to restore civilian rule.
